description_en: Jati Bāhāḥ, a branch of the Oku Bāhāḥ (Rudravarṇa Mahāvihāra,LAL2260), is located on the way to Sundhārā from Oku Bāhāḥ. It can be accessed via an entry door to the east of this street and through a narrow alley with images of Mahākāla and Acala (Saṅkaṭa) attached to the left of the northern wall. The main shrine building is located to the east of the courtyard. Thebāhāhhas been reconstructed in RCC and is now a four-storey building. The ground floor and the first floor are dedicated to the deity, while the two upper floors are used for residential purposes. A large carved door with lattice door-leaves serves as the main entrance to the ground floor, and is flanked by small lattice windows on either side. The ground floor and the first floor are separated from one another with timber cornice details typical to this kind of structure. The first floor has a centralpāsukājhyāḥwith five openings and two aedicules on either side. The carved door of the sanctum is flanked by two small windows, though it has notoraṇanor guardian animals. The first floor is home to theāgama.Aśikharakūṭa caitya(150 cm high) can be found in front of the main shrine. The courtyard measures 9.6 m × 9.6 m and has recently been paved with interlocking concrete blocks. An 88 cm deep plinth surrounds the courtyard on all sides. One traditional building remains and can be found at the south-west corner of the courtyard. The rest of the buildings are tall RCC buildings. The courtyard also contains a statue of the consecrator of thebāhāh.Thisbāhāhwas established by Devasiṃha after he established the Naudvã Bāhāḥ in NS 760 (Locke1985, 105;Śākya1994, 84)He established Jati Bāhāḥ a few days later (Śākya1994, 99).
description_ne: सुन्धाराबाट दक्षिणतिर हेरी ओकुबाहा: जाँदा बाटोको पूर्वतिर यो विहार अवस्थित छ । यसलाईजयतिवर्णविहार(Locke 1985, 105),जयनिवर्णविहार(Sinclair 2010, 28-29) पनि भनिन्छ । विहारमै टाँसिएको ताम्रपत्रमा यसलाईजयवर्द्धनविहारभनिएको छ । यो रुद्रवर्ण महाविहार, ओकुबाहा:को शाखा विहार हो । आधुनिक घरको कलात्मक ढोकाबाट भित्र छिरेपछि खुल्ला प्राङ्गणमा पूर्वतिर विहार बनाइएको छ । आधुनिक प्रविधिले ढलान गरी बनाइएको निजी घरको दुई तला विहारको लागि छुट्याइएको छ । भुइँतलामा विहारको गर्भगृह रहेको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोका कलात्मक बनाइएको छ तर ढोकामाथि तोरण, दायाँ-बायाँ सिंह राखिएको छैन । ढोकाको दायाँ-बायाँ एक-एकवटा साना झ्यालहरू राखिएका छन् । पहिलो तलामा विहारको आगम रहेको छ । यस तलामा बीचमा पासुखा झ्याल राखिएको छ भने त्यसको दायाँ-बायाँ एक-एकवटा साना झ्यालहरू राखिएका छन् । झ्यालमाथि सजावटका लागि विभिन्न देवीदेवताका मुकुण्डोहरू राखिएका छन् । विहारलाई कलात्मक देखाउन नयाँ टुँडालहरू पनि राखिएका छन् । विहार परिसरमा एउटा शिखरकूट चैत्य र विहारका निर्माता देवसिंहको प्रतिमा राखिएको छ ।यो विहार नौद्वँ बाहा:का देवसिंहले बनाएका थिए । देवसिंहले नेसं ७६० मा नौद्वँ बाहा: बनाएका थिए(Locke 1985, 105;Śākya 1994, 84)भने त्यसको केही वर्षपछि उनैले जतिबाहा: पनि बनाएका थिए (Śākya 1994, 99)।

historical_events.event_description: The prayer wheels to the west of thecaityawere donated in memory of Viṣṇu Māyā Śākya in NS 1112. The donation was made  by her family.
The oil-lamp balustrade surrounding thecaityawas donated in memory of Viṣṇu Māyā Śākya in NS 1117. The donation was made by her family.
